prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit, but first I need a bit more information.

Quick questions so I can give a tailored shortlist:
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, sales/conversions, PR, product launch, etc.)
- Which services do you need most? (branding, creative, website design, SEO, paid ads, social media, content, PR, analytics)
- B2B or B2C?
- Rough monthly budget or campaign budget range?
- Company size / team (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Do you require a local KC agency (in-person) or is remote acceptable?
- Any timeline or must-launch dates?

How I’ll evaluate agencies (so you know what “best” means here)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (not just pretty work)
- Experience in your industry or with similar-sized clients
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence
- Team you’ll work with day-to-day (skills + senior oversight)
- Transparency on pricing, tools and contract terms
- Client references and retention history
- Cultural fit / communication style

If you want to look yourself, good places to search and compare local agencies:
- Clutch.co (reviews & case studies)
- Ad Age Agency Report / Adweek lists
- Google Maps + Yelp for local reviews
- LinkedIn for agency teams and client connections
- Kansas City Business Journal / local industry awards

If you give me the details above, I’ll put together a short, prioritized list of Kansas City agencies that match your needs (3–5 options), with a quick reason why each could be a good fit and sample questions to ask them.
